uncited: *   **Input:** A trained NeRF model and its corresponding Instant-NGP multiscale occupancy grid consisting of $K$ grids $G_k$ for $k \in [1, K]$.
*   **Output:** An updated multiscale occupancy grid where artifact clusters have been pruned (occupancy set to 0), and a rendering process that omits these cells.
*   Each grid $G_k$ has a resolution of $128^3$ cells $C_k(x_I, y_I, z_I)$.
**Initialize Clustering:** Pick an occupied cell from $O$ that is not assigned to a cluster, at random.
**Flood Fill:** Any time a cell is assigned to a cluster, assign any occupied cell adjacent to it (sharing a non-zero area border) to the same cluster.
**Identify Relevant Clusters:** For scenes fulfilling the coherence assumption, the cluster covering the most volume depicts the relevant coherent scene geometry.
**Mark Artifacts:** Clusters left unlabeled are assumed to be artifacts.
**Update Lower Resolution Grids:** For each $k > 1$, iterate through cells in $G_k \cap G_{k-1}$ (cells not in $O$).
Each cell in $G_k$ contains 8 cells in $G_{k-1}$.
If none of those 8 child cells in $G_{k-1}$ is occupied after the update, set the occupancy value of the parent cell in $G_k$ to 0.
*   **Precision and Boundaries:** The method relies on the assumption that artifacts do not share neighboring cells with coherent geometry.
*   **Resolution Mismatch:** Floaters close to relevant scene geometry may be removed from higher resolution grids but not from lower resolution grids.
*   **Time Complexity:** The clustering step involves a flood fill over the set $O$.
The size of $O$ is proportional to the number of occupied cells in the finest grid plus the shell cells of coarser grids.
The update step iterates through coarser grids.
Overall complexity is linear with respect to the number of cells in the occupancy grid.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing the occupancy grid and the set $O$.
No additional large data structures are needed.
It leverages the multiscale occupancy grid of Instant-NGP to perform a neighborhood-based global clustering.

Occupancy Clustering is a post-processing technique for Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) that removes floating artifacts by identifying and pruning volumetric regions in the Instant-NGP multiscale occupancy grid that are structurally severed from the canonical scene geometry [S1].

The claim states that Occupancy Clustering is a post-processing technique for NeRFs (specifically Instant-NGP) that removes floating artifacts by identifying and pruning volumetric regions in the multiscale occupancy grid that are structurally severed from the canonical scene geometry. Source [S1] explicitly describes this process: it uses a neighborhood-based global clustering algorithm on the Instant-NGP multiscale occupancy grid to identify coherent clusters. It assumes the relevant scene is one coherent volume, and clusters not coherent with this core (i.e., structurally severed/isolated) are identified as artifacts and pruned (occupancy set to 0). The source confirms this is a post-processing step applied to the trained NeRF model's occupancy grid to eliminate floaters.
